```{python}
#| label: fig-sv-ctrl-fsm-mealy
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "State diagram of the controller as a Mealy FSM. Each arc carries its condition and, after the slash, the outputs `busy_o` and `done_o` in the clock cycle in which the condition holds. `done_o` is high on the arc from `StRun` back to `StIdle`, in the same cycle as `last_i`."
#| fig-alt: "State diagram with two states. StIdle is entered at reset. The arc from StIdle to StRun is labeled start_i slash 00, the loop on StIdle not start_i slash 00. The loop on StRun is labeled not last_i slash 10, and the arc from StRun back to StIdle last_i slash 11."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white')
    r, fs = 0.75, 11

    def state(xy, text):
        return flow.State(r=r).at(xy).anchor('center').fill('#dae8fc').color('#6c8ebf').label(text, color='black')

    idle = state((0, 0), 'StIdle')
    run = state((4.6, 0), 'StRun')

    # arcs: condition / busy_o done_o in the clock cycle in which the condition holds
    flow.Arc2(arrow='->', k=0.35).at(idle.NE).to(run.NW).color('black') \
        .label('start_i / 00', 'top', fontsize=fs, color='black')
    flow.Arc2(arrow='->', k=0.35).at(run.SW).to(idle.SE).color('black') \
        .label('last_i / 11', 'bottom', fontsize=fs, color='black')
    flow.ArcLoop(arrow='->', radius=0.6).at(idle.SW).to(idle.NW).color('black') \
        .label('!start_i / 00', 'left', ofst=0.1, fontsize=fs, color='black')
    flow.ArcLoop(arrow='->', radius=0.6).at(run.NE).to(run.SE).color('black') \
        .label('!last_i / 10', 'right', ofst=0.1, fontsize=fs, color='black')

    # asynchronous reset
    flow.Arrow().at((0, 2.0)).to(idle.N).color('black').label('reset', 'top', fontsize=fs, color='black')
```
